label: Cloisonne Enamel
blurb: Remakes the picture as cloisonne: fine gold wires bent along every boundary between its colours and soldered to a plate, each little cell filled with ground glass and fired until it melts into glossy enamel. The enamel is deep and rich at the edges where it climbs the wire and glows lighter in the middle of each cell, tiny air bubbles are trapped in the glass, the polished surface is not quite flat so the highlight wanders across it, and the round wires catch the light along their tops.
